Formula.text:
Select DateDiff ("d", {invoice.due_date}, CurrentDate)
Case Is < 1 :
    "Current"
Case 1 To 30 :
    "1-30"
Case 31 To 60 :
    "31-60"
Case 61 To 90 :
    "61-90"
Default :
    "90+"
